clue.text: About to get the wrong answer

parts.note: RE is a short word for about or concerning, as in business letters
a tort is a civil wrong in law

explanation.surface: Someone is just about to give the incorrect reply to a question.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to get the' simply joins the pieces. The definition is a noun: a sharp reply.
explanation.definitionFit: A retort is a quick, sharp reply, a kind of response.

clue.text: Keeps dissolving in tears

indicators.note: dissolving means breaking up, so the letters of the two words are broken up and re-formed

explanation.surface: Someone holds on while breaking down weeping.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dissolving' rearranges the seven letters of IN TEARS.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep something is to hold on to it, a synonym.

clue.text: Circulatory system made one walk to work

definitions.text: Circulatory system made one walk to work

parts.words: Circulatory system made one walk to work
parts.note: read not as blood vessels but as a belt that goes round and round, forcing whoever stands on it to walk as a chore

explanation.surface: It sounds like biology: a heart condition forcing someone to walk to the office.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Circulatory' tempts you towards blood; here it means going round, as the endless belt of an exercise or prison machine does.
explanation.definitionFit: This machine has a looping belt you keep walking on, once a prison punishment and now gym equipment.

clue.text: Say no to waste

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means decline; as a noun it means rubbish, household litter.

clue.text: One that's drunk is off to the dance

parts.note: meat or game that is off has gone high
a ball is a formal dance

explanation.surface: Someone tipsy heads out to a dance party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One that's drunk' is not a drunk person but a drink that gets drunk. 'is' and 'to the' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: A tall mixed drink of spirits and soda, so something consumed by drinkers.

clue.text: One person of intelligence provides game for children

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a spy gathers intelligence, meaning secret information

explanation.surface: A clever individual supplies entertainment for kids.
explanation.walkthrough: 'intelligence' suggests brains but means espionage. The game is the guessing game 'I spy with my little eye'.
explanation.definitionFit: A guessing pastime where a player names a letter of something they can see.

clue.text: Attractive homes — and well-designed

indicators.note: designed means laid out afresh, so the letters are arranged into a new form

explanation.surface: Houses that look good and are well planned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'well-designed' rearranges the eight letters of HOMES AND.
explanation.definitionFit: Good-looking, a synonym for attractive.

clue.text: Stay in Lincoln — I would

indicators.note: in tells us one piece goes inside another here

parts.note: Abe is the nickname of US president Abraham Lincoln
I'd is the contracted form of I would

explanation.surface: Someone says they would happily stay in the city of Lincoln.
explanation.walkthrough: Lincoln looks like the English cathedral city, but it is the US president Abraham Lincoln, known by his nickname.
explanation.definitionFit: To remain or dwell somewhere, a synonym of stay.

clue.text: Open boat in spill

definitions.meaning: a flat-bottomed barge for unloading ships
a spill is a thin strip of wood or paper used to light a fire or pipe

explanation.surface: An unroofed vessel caught up in an accident at sea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spill' looks like an accident; it is the paper taper used for lighting fires.
explanation.definitionFit: A barge used to unload cargo, and also anything used for kindling a flame, such as a taper.

clue.text: Drive cancelled after drink, we hear

indicators.note: after puts one piece behind another
we hear means we take the word as spoken, not as it is spelt

parts.note: tea is a drink
an event that is cancelled is off

explanation.surface: A car journey was called off after a cup of something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drive' looks like motoring; it is the golfer's opening drive.
explanation.definitionFit: In golf, the first shot from the tee is a drive.

clue.text: Smart from physical punishment

definitions.meaning: smart in the sense of brisk or fine

explanation.surface: Something stings because of a beating.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Smart' reads as the verb to sting; it is the adjective meaning fine or lively. 'from' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Means lively or excellent as an adjective, and a smacking as a noun.

clue.text: Sole aid for a climber

parts.note: the sole is the underside of a boot, and this aid is the spiked frame strapped there for ice

explanation.surface: It sounds like the only help a mountaineer has.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sole' reads as only; it means the bottom of the foot or boot.
explanation.definitionFit: A metal plate with spikes fixed to a boot for gripping ice when climbing.

clue.text: Venture on the river for work

indicators.note: on puts one piece after another

parts.note: the Indus is a major river of Pakistan
to venture is to try

explanation.surface: A risky trip taken on the river for one's job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Hard work or diligence, an older sense still used of a hard-working person.

clue.text: Acquiesce when told to go

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
someone sent away has been told to go

explanation.surface: Someone gives in when ordered to leave.
explanation.definitionFit: To agree or consent quietly, a synonym of acquiesce.

clue.text: The S. African flag

parts.note: not a national banner but a flag in the plant sense, an iris-like flower native to southern Africa

explanation.surface: It looks like a question about South Africa's national banner.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flag' is a name for an iris, and this scented iris-family plant comes from South Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: A fragrant bulb plant of the iris family, native to South Africa; 'flag' names irises.

clue.text: Take off in second gear

parts.note: kit is gear or equipment

explanation.surface: A driver moves away in second gear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Take off' is a noun here: a comic imitation. 'in' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A short comic sketch that parodies something, a send-up.

clue.text: I am easily shocked at city giving licence to print

parts.note: I'm is the short form of I am
a prim person is easily shocked
Ur is the ancient city of Mesopotamia

explanation.surface: A prudish person says they are offended by a city granting permission to publish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'giving' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Official permission, originally from church authorities, allowing a book to be published.

clue.text: Dates may be seen around this place

definitions.text: Dates may be seen around this place

parts.words: Dates may be seen around this place
parts.note: dates are not calendar days but palm fruit, grown along the shores of a body of water between Africa and Arabia

explanation.surface: It reads like a historical site marked with important anniversaries.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dates' suggests history; it means the fruit of date palms, which flourish around this sea.
explanation.definitionFit: The sea between Egypt and Arabia, whose shores are lined with date palms.

clue.text: When special forces transgress with killer

parts.note: as can mean when
the SAS is the British Army's Special Air Service
to sin is to transgress

explanation.surface: Elite troops break the rules alongside a murderer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A murderer, especially one who kills a public figure.

clue.text: Very important events, by the way

definitions.meaning: landmark moments in a life or history
literally, stones set by the roadside marking distances

explanation.definitionFit: Significant turning points, and the roadside markers showing distances.

clue.text: I study among graduates — young females

indicators.note: among puts one piece in the middle of another

parts.note: MAs are Masters of Arts, graduates
a den is a private study

explanation.surface: A student among university graduates meets young women.
explanation.definitionFit: Girls or unmarried young women, an old-fashioned synonym.

clue.text: Not the gardener's favourite little-tie number

parts.note: wee is Scottish for little
D is the Roman numeral 500

explanation.surface: Something small that the person tending the garden dislikes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: An unwanted plant that a gardener pulls up, hardly their best-loved.

clue.text: Upbraided a fool, perhaps

indicators.note: in a down clue up means reading from bottom to top, so the word is turned around

parts.note: tressed means braided, of hair

explanation.surface: Someone told off a silly person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Upbraided' looks like one word meaning scolded; split it into 'Up' and 'braided'. A fool is a fruit-and-cream pudding.
explanation.definitionFit: A fool is a pudding of fruit and cream, an example of a sweet course.

clue.text: Prime object of care

definitions.meaning: to prime a gun is to load it
a ward or person someone looks after

explanation.definitionFit: To load a firearm, and a person in someone's care.

clue.text: This club is for swinging types

definitions.text: This club is for swinging types

parts.words: This club is for swinging types
parts.note: a club here is not a society but a bottle-shaped wooden club swung in exercise

explanation.surface: It sounds like a club for partner-swapping people.
explanation.walkthrough: 'club' suggests a society; Indian clubs are wooden bats swung for exercise.
explanation.definitionFit: Indian clubs are bottle-shaped clubs swung in gymnastic exercise.

clue.text: First of the drinkers finished the port

indicators.note: first of tells us to take only the opening letter of the next word

parts.note: over means finished

explanation.surface: The leading drinker has drained the port wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'port' suggests the drink; it is the English Channel port in Kent.
explanation.definitionFit: The Kent harbour town is a ferry port facing France.

clue.text: Elevation above the peerage?

definitions.meaning: a title used for royalty, who rank above dukes and earls

explanation.definitionFit: Means loftiness, and a royal form of address ranking above nobility.

clue.text: Old silver used before notes

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
E and D are musical notes

explanation.surface: Antique silverware used ahead of the musical notes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'used before' is a link phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Elderly, a synonym for old.

clue.text: Have a look at something that isn't actually there

definitions.text: Have a look at something that isn't actually there

parts.words: Have a look at something that isn't actually there
parts.note: seeing in the mind's eye, picturing what does not exist yet

explanation.surface: It sounds like seeing a ghost or a mirage.
explanation.definitionFit: To imagine or picture something as a future possibility.

clue.text: Off course, he was shipwrecked

indicators.note: off course suggests a ship gone astray, and off signals these letters wander

explanation.surface: A ship strayed off course and its sailor was wrecked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Off' rearranges the letters of COURSE. Robinson Crusoe is Defoe's castaway.
explanation.definitionFit: Defoe's fictional castaway was marooned on an island after a shipwreck.

clue.text: Song composed about the present time

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so one piece is placed around another

parts.note: a composed person is serene
AD, anno domini, marks the current era

explanation.surface: A tune written about today.
explanation.walkthrough: 'composed' looks like an anagram signal or songwriting; it means calm.
explanation.definitionFit: A love song sung at night, typically beneath a window.

clue.text: Quibbler makes notes in exercise book

indicators.note: in puts one piece inside another

parts.note: PE is physical education
NT is the New Testament
D and A are musical notes

explanation.surface: A nitpicker writes remarks in a school exercise book.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exercise book' looks like a single school item, but it splits into two separate abbreviations. 'makes' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: A fusspot who quibbles over minor details and rules.
